column434: Timeless Los Verdes home with ocean views, classic character, and thoughtful upgrades throughout. A rare opportunity to own a special home in one of Palos Verdes’ most desirable neighborhoods.

The property also features a three-car garage plus additional off-street parking accessed from the alley behind the home an invaluable convenience on Paseo Del Mar. The backyard offers ample space for a pool and spa, or can be enjoyed as a spacious lawn and patio retreat.Completely reimagined from the foundation up using the finest materials and craftsmanship, this home represents the pinnacle of modern coastal living. Residents also enjoy the opportunity to join the Palos Verdes Golf & Tennis Club and the Palos Verdes Beach & Athletic Club, further enhancing the lifestyle that makes Palos Verdes Estates so special.  Conveniently located close to the elementary, middle, and high schools.

column434: Old-world Tuscan charm meets elevated coastal living in a home that knows how to make an entrance—and then casually steals the show. With nearly 6,500 sq ft of light-filled living, this Palos Verdes Estates beauty delivers grand scale without a hint of stiffness. Think impressive, inviting, and surprisingly easy to live in. The main level includes a chef’s kitchen where weeknight dinners turn into lingering conversations—and full-blown celebrations feel effortless. Quartzite countertops, an oversized island, dual sinks, triple Wolf ovens, and multiple Sub-Zero refrigerators make hosting feel natural, while the fully equipped butler’s pantry (yes, it has its own Wolf oven and wine fridge) keeps things running smoothly behind the scenes. Custom barn doors add a touch of charm, and statement chandeliers and tray ceilings bring just the right amount of drama. Walls of glass frame sweeping ocean and city coastal views which flood the home with sunshine, while architectural moments—like the show-stopping spiral staircase—deliver wow factor in all the right places. Five generously sized en-suite bedrooms (four of them conveniently located on the main level) ensure comfort and privacy for everyone, and the primary suite feels like a private spa escape you’ll look forward to retreating to every night. A rich, wood-clad English pub brings a cozy old-soul vibe—perfect for laid-back evenings and well-earned nightcaps. Plus, the main floor offers easy access to nearly every corner of the home plus the backyard, making indoor-outdoor living a breeze. Step outside and the vibe shifts to full-on resort mode. Spanning nearly 19,000 sq ft, the grounds feature a pool and spa, outdoor kitchen with built-in BBQ, fire pit, multiple patios for gathering, and grassy spaces perfect for play, lounging, or sunset toasts. When it’s time to switch gears, the elevator makes heading downstairs effortless, whether you’re settling in for movie night in the private theater, hosting guests in the guest bedroom, or breaking a sweat in the flexible bonus room—currently living its best life as a gym. The expansive front lawn creates a grand arrival, but it’s the sweeping coastline views and iconic Queen’s Necklace from both levels that really steal the spotlight—especially when the lights start to sparkle. Designed for unforgettable moments, easy entertaining, and everyday living that feels a little more magical—this is one home that knows how to have a good time (and look very good doing it).

column434: Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac and directly across from the prestigious Palos Verdes Golf Club, this beautifully updated home sits on an expansive 20,000+ square foot lot and offers commanding views of both the golf course and the Pacific Ocean from six private balconies. A large family and game room with a fireplace and built-in bar anchors the lower level, along with a dedicated laundry room and generous storage space perfect for a wine cellar or additional use. This home has been extensively upgraded throughout, including all new PEX plumbing, complete electrical rewiring, dual zone HVAC with two new heaters, two air conditioning units, all new ducting, and designer air registers. A tankless gas water heater, new Toto bidet toilets, Brizo plumbing fixtures, and a Generac backup generator add comfort and convenience throughout. All renovations and upgrades were completed with proper city permits and approvals, ensuring quality, safety, and long term peace of mind. The finished three car garage features vaulted ceilings, recessed lighting, and space for a car lift, while the wide driveway provides ample additional parking. The landscaped backyard includes mature fruit trees and space for a future garden or retreat. With thoughtful updates, panoramic views, and a prime location, 5 Yellow Brick Road offers a rare opportunity to enjoy refined coastal living with comfort, style, and room to grow.
